statement: In pinned SDL 3.2.0, the Linux joystick event backend yields to higher-priority joystick drivers only when they report an equivalent present device. When the Xbox 360 HIDAPI driver is disabled through the relevant hint or no accessible and initialized matching HIDAPI device is present, Linux evdev can enumerate a standard-HID UHID controller as an ordinary joystick and use its event capabilities and gamepad mapping instead of the native XUSB HIDAPI report decoder. This fallback is conditional on kernel evdev creation and app access; source code does not establish which backend Steam, Eden or any particular installed SDL build used.
